item.title: CVE-2026-22311 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | The failed-login limiter of the JTL-Wawi synchronisation interface of JTL-Shop derives the client identity from the client-controlled X-Forwarded-For header and counts requests without credentials as failed logins. An unauthenticated remote attacker can block the synchronisation between JTL-Shop and JTL-Wawi with a few requests and repeat this indefinitely, so that orders are no longer handed over to JTL-Wawi. No data is disclosed and no code is executed.

item.title: CVE-2026-85413 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Thursday 19 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The Foxtool All-in-One: Contact chat button, Custom login, Media optimize images plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'foxtool_image_id' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.5.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. A subscriber-level attacker can store a payload in their own profile's foxtoolpic user-meta that executes in an administrator's browser session when the administrator views the user via the Users → Edit screen.
